programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E02
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In the far corner of the Pacific Ocean lies New Zealand, cut off from the rest of the world since the time of the dinosaurs. Fauna and flora developed here in a unique way. In this lost world, nature has special rules: penguins in the forest, parrots in the snow and predators as if taken straight from prehistoric times. Representatives of flora and fauna must struggle with the geological forces that have provided the beauty of this land. Here you can meet pioneers conquering mountain peaks, dolphins emerging from the depths of the sea, and birds hunting with masterful agility over hot streams. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Highlands | E01
programme.desc: The Scottish Highlands are dominated by rocky hills and valleys. Climate change and humans have caused many changes in the region. Despite this, many wild animals still live here. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Leopard, sand and heat | E02
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Leopards live in thousands of ecosystems, from the rainforests of India to the driest regions of Africa; they adapt to almost any climate, feeding on over 100 different species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – In extreme conditions | S01E03
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks, which appeared on Earth before dinosaurs, have adapted to life even in the most unfavorable environments. Scientists are investigating the secret of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Monsters from the depths | E01
programme.desc: Steve Backshall will show viewers the world of giants located in the depths of the sea. Thanks to the help of experts and biologists, they will learn more about the giant squid, anglerfish, megalodon, and other fascinating animal species. The presenter will present creatures inhabiting the depths of the sea and their behavior. He will present, among others: anglerfish and black snailfish, which can be found at depths of 500-3800 m below sea level. Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.title: ⋗ Volleyball. Russia. Super League. Men. Qualifying round. Dynamo-Ural (Ufa) – Belogorye (Belgorod)
programme.desc: The series about the three-hundred-year history of the Romanov dynasty in Russia is designed for the widest audience, but the time frame of the events described is somewhat wider than the reign of the Romanov dynasty. The geography of the series is also very extensive. In addition to Moscow, the authors visited Vladimir, Uglich, Kostroma, St. Petersburg and its environs. The Belarusian Mogilev, which for two years was practically the third capital of Russia for two years, was not ignored. In addition, the seaside cities of Azov, Taganrog and Livadia were not forgotten. The film uses rare footage of the Valaam archipelago, where Alexander I made a pilgrimage, asking for blessings for his feat. The main task of the authors of the series can be considered that they tried to tell the audience a three-hundred-year history popularly and vividly, without archival dust. Director: Alexey Pishchulin. Cast: Andrey Smirnov, Andrey Bogdanov, Denis Solodovnikov, Sergey Nilov, Nina Sorotokina, Evgeny Anisimov. Russia, 2013, biography

programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Stormborn»…In the third and final part of the Stormborn trilogy, the animals of the north face worsening weather in Autumn and the first stirrings of winter. Grey seals and reindeer turn their attention to mating, hormones run wild as males compete and young animals venture away from their parents for the first time. In Iceland, the cliff arctic fox family is thriving, but it's a different story for the foxes denning at the shore line. Only one of the cubs has survived, now abandoned by her parents, she must fend for herself. On the Monach Isles, 35,000 grey seals arrive for the annual breeding season. A pup faces danger on the beach, getting lost and swept up into a fight between two raging bulls. As winter arrives, the reindeer herd in Norway must migrate to their grazing grounds in the mountains but this involves a perilous two-mile swim across open water | Nature documentary narrated by Ewan McGregor. Stormborn follows the resilient animals surviving in the harsh, arctic and subarctic, conditions of Iceland, the Shetlands and the Monach Isles. We see how creatures as diverse as reindeer, arctic fox, puffins, seals and otters manage to live in such a demanding environment | Director: Jackie Savery | Cast: Ewan McGregor

programme.title: Stormborn: Children of the Storm (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Stormborn»…In the third and final part of the Stormborn trilogy, the animals of the north face worsening weather in Autumn and the first stirrings of winter. Grey seals and reindeer turn their attention to mating, hormones run wild as males compete and young animals venture away from their parents for the first time. In Iceland, the cliff arctic fox family is thriving, but it's a different story for the foxes denning at the shore line. Only one of the cubs has survived, now abandoned by her parents, she must fend for herself. On the Monach Isles, 35,000 grey seals arrive for the annual breeding season. A pup faces danger on the beach, getting lost and swept up into a fight between two raging bulls. As winter arrives, the reindeer herd in Norway must migrate to their grazing grounds in the mountains but this involves a perilous two-mile swim across open water | Nature documentary narrated by Ewan McGregor. Stormborn follows the resilient animals surviving in the harsh, arctic and subarctic, conditions of Iceland, the Shetlands and the Monach Isles. We see how creatures as diverse as reindeer, arctic fox, puffins, seals and otters manage to live in such a demanding environment | Director: Jackie Savery | Cast: Ewan McGregor

programme.title: d/f Big cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. The plot centers on several families, each of them daily fighting a difficult struggle for survival in the savannah. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. Two lion cubs, born during the dry season, find themselves on the brink of starvation because their mother Kali runs out of milk. Desperate to feed her cubs, she finds and eats the carcass of a dead hippopotamus... A lonely male cheetah, Moto, falls in love with Nyota. At first they become friends, and soon start a family. But one day Nyota disappears, and Moto goes in search of her across the endless African plains. Dir.: Jongyul Lee. South Korea, 2019

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: At around 3,000 km long, the Danube (Gorge of the Iron Gates) is only the second longest river in Europe, but it is the most international in the world: it flows through ten countries and four capitals, Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade. The Danube is less a border river than a transport artery connecting peoples. The Danube is also important as a fascinating natural paradise that is home to over 2,000 animal and plant species.

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: Three rivers, three continents: habitats and stories from the Yukon, the Danube and the Zambezi. The start is from Canada to Alaska, where the 3120 km long Yukon makes its way until it flows into the Bering Sea. When the huge river freezes over completely in winter, it becomes a legendary ice highway through the untouched nature of North America. The wildlife along the river is also fascinating: whether grizzlies, huge herds of reindeer, massive elk, lynx or agile salmon - many unique animal species can be found around or in the river. \n\nSince temperatures down to minus 50 degrees are not uncommon in winter, only a few people live along the Yukon. In a few smaller towns and remote settlements, people are defying the harsh conditions. In some cases the settlements can only be reached via the river.

programme.desc: The nature of the American Wild West is extreme, with coastlines punctuated by cliffs. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Mexico
programme.desc: In the north of Mexico, the rules of two sand worlds apply: the Sonoran and the Chihuahua deserts require perfect adaptability from the animals that want to survive here. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Underwater filmmaker Ken O'Sullivan follows in the footsteps of early explorers. He encounters the most diverse and impressive sea creatures in the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: At around 3,000 km long, the Danube (Gorge of the Iron Gates) is only the second longest river in Europe, but it is the most international in the world: it flows through ten countries and four capitals, Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade. The Danube is less a border river than a transport artery connecting peoples. The Danube is also important as a fascinating natural paradise that is home to over 2,000 animal and plant species.

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: Three rivers, three continents: habitats and stories from the Yukon, the Danube and the Zambezi. The start is from Canada to Alaska, where the 3120 km long Yukon makes its way until it flows into the Bering Sea. When the huge river freezes over completely in winter, it becomes a legendary ice highway through the untouched nature of North America. The wildlife along the river is also fascinating: whether grizzlies, huge herds of reindeer, massive elk, lynx or agile salmon - many unique animal species can be found around or in the river. \n\nSince temperatures down to minus 50 degrees are not uncommon in winter, only a few people live along the Yukon. In a few smaller towns and remote settlements, people are defying the harsh conditions. In some cases the settlements can only be reached via the river.

programme.title: Animalically aloof
programme.desc: Elegant fliers and agile hunters: animals such as hummingbirds, sparrowhawks and albatrosses overcome gravity with unique flight techniques and thus ensure their survival. (Station info).

programme.title: The fascination of skin – the organ of superlatives
programme.desc: Biologist Ben Garrod demonstrates the limits of human skin in a self-test. In animals, this versatile organ offers protection from environmental influences - and for some it is even used for communication. (Station info).

programme.title: Dogs out of control
programme.desc: Tough task for Graeme: The Akitas Yumi and Yuna attack their fellow dogs and make every walk a torture for their owner Maria. Mixed-breed Pippa, on the other hand, is so hungry that he sometimes bites when someone tampers with his bowl.

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. Tào Tháo cố gắng chiêu mộ Quan Vũ vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Quan trung thành với người anh em kết nghĩa Lưu Bị, cũng là kẻ thù của Tào Tháo. Khi Quan cố gắng giải cứu vợ lẽ của Lưu Bị khỏi tay Tào Tháo, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu để vượt qua. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR
programme.desc: Để chống lại hiệu ứng nhà kính, nhà khoa học Yan Xin cố gắng trồng những hạt giống siêu cao su mới được phát triển trên một hòn đảo xa xôi với hy vọng biến nó thành một vùng đất mới thịnh vượng. Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!
